search.accounting_source: all non-fold, non-stress rapid_runs rows in the program's initially empty Rapid store
search.method: coarse exploration, early rejection, then bounded neighbor checks

operator_constraints.range_enforcement: operator command scope plus final rapid_runs date audit

exposure_ledger.permitted_use: rapid discovery, walk-forward, stress, robustness, and controlled replay

families.hypothesis: Positive trailing returns identify assets whose exposure should remain invested; otherwise hold cash.
configurations_tested: Rapid-002 40/40/10 remained closed and was not rerun
families.rejection_or_survival_reason: Single-horizon and multi-horizon variants were benchmark-inferior or unstable out of sample; the prior Rapid-002 risk-managed point remains permanently rejected.

families.hypothesis: The strongest positive-momentum ETFs outperform an unfiltered fixed allocation.
families.rejection_or_survival_reason: The strongest point compounded 49.95% out of sample versus 56.35% for SPY and retained losing folds and concentration weakness.

families.hypothesis: Cross-sectional winners should be held only when their own momentum is positive, with defensive assets or cash as fallback.
configurations_tested: dual-momentum: 362 parents, 6 walk-forward parents, 54 folds, 8 stresses
families.rejection_or_survival_reason: Old dual-momentum survivors failed fixed-block fill, concentration, benchmark, or neighbor gates. A uniform audit of all 84 complete fixed-block identities found four diversified-defense base passes; their minimum one-parameter neighbor retentions were -43.4%, -9.9%, 12.9%, and 39.1%.

families.hypothesis: State changes around trailing moving averages reduce drawdown without repeated identical resizing.
families.rejection_or_survival_reason: State and continuous moving-average variants were benchmark-inferior and did not justify stricter evaluation.

families.hypothesis: New channel highs begin persistent moves while shorter channel lows provide deterministic exits.
families.rejection_or_survival_reason: Channel variants were weak, cost-sensitive, and benchmark-inferior.

families.hypothesis: Short pullbacks inside established uptrends recover before their longer trend fails.
families.rejection_or_survival_reason: Pullback and reversal variants were weak or transaction-cost dominated.

families.hypothesis: Reducing exposure or weight to volatile assets improves risk-adjusted net returns.
families.rejection_or_survival_reason: Volatility targeting and balancing did not add enough return or drawdown value over simple benchmarks; Rapid-002 risk-managed momentum was not retried.

families.hypothesis: Capped inverse-volatility weights diversify risk better than equal capital weights.
families.rejection_or_survival_reason: The bounded inverse-volatility approximation was benchmark-inferior; optimizer complexity was not justified.

families.hypothesis: SPY trend plus realized volatility can switch between equal risk-asset and defensive sleeves before execution.
configurations_tested: regime-allocation: 247 parents, 4 walk-forward parents, 36 folds, 6 stresses
families.rejection_or_survival_reason: Regime 84/30/15/21 led walk-forward at 94.26% with all folds positive, but fixed blocks produced only 67 fills and a worst Sharpe of 0.415. Regime 63/20/20/21 passed the other visible base gates but produced only 62 fills.

families.hypothesis: When risk assets lack positive momentum, rotating to the stronger positive TLT or GLD signal improves drawdown and concentration.
configurations_tested: dual-momentum and diversified-dual-momentum counts are recorded under family C
families.rejection_or_survival_reason: Single-defense variants remained concentrated or inactive; diversified TLT/GLD fallback reduced concentration but did not survive fixed parameter neighbors.

families.hypothesis: A trend-filtered, momentum-ranked active subset can trade several times per month while remaining diversified.
configurations_tested: dual-momentum, diversified-dual-momentum, and multi-horizon counts are recorded under families C and L
families.rejection_or_survival_reason: The active-subset variants either missed benchmark, concentration, activity, or neighbor-retention gates.

families.hypothesis: Agreement between short and long momentum horizons is less fragile than one optimized lookback.
configurations_tested: dual-family counts are recorded under family C
families.rejection_or_survival_reason: Multi-horizon agreement did not beat the walk-forward benchmarks; dual variants had stronger returns but failed later base or neighbor gates.

families.hypothesis: Independent momentum, trend, and volatility conditions can filter weak exposures without an opaque score.
configurations_tested: dual, diversified-dual, regime-allocation, and trend-pullback counts are recorded in their primary families
families.rejection_or_survival_reason: Economically interpretable combinations were tested through dual momentum, regime allocation, and trend pullback; none cleared the complete gate set.

families.hypothesis: A deterministic SPY trailing-drawdown trigger can reduce risk-asset exposure without future information.
families.rejection_or_survival_reason: Deterministic de-risking reduced exposure but was materially benchmark-inferior.

families.hypothesis: Requiring positive signal strength before investment avoids weak exposures.
configurations_tested: positive-signal cash and defensive fallbacks were exercised across momentum, relative-strength, and both dual families
families.rejection_or_survival_reason: Cash and defensive filters improved some drawdowns but did not produce a robust candidate that cleared benchmark, concentration, activity, and neighbor gates together.

families.hypothesis: Equal-weight top-N positive signals reduce single-instrument dependence as part of the strategy design.
configurations_tested: equal-weight top-2/top-3 variants were tested across multi-horizon, dual, and diversified-dual families
families.rejection_or_survival_reason: Equal-weight top-N construction reduced full-range concentration, but every visible-base survivor failed fixed-fold parameter-neighbor retention.

final_cohort.selection_reason: The read-only parent-disposition query classified all 1,219 parents and uniformly screened all 84 complete fixed-block identities. Five passed the base gates and all five failed the one-parameter neighbor screen, so no candidate deserved research promotion.

delivery.closeout_attestation_note: The annotated tag points to exact merged closeout main and records the final main, closeout PR and merge SHA, report, ledger, screen, and Rapid database SHA-256 values, exact open-PR and branch counts, and protected-state confirmations without a recursive in-file commit hash.

protected_state.verification: The Rapid database proves that all 1,395 rows use the one allowed dataset and fingerprint, stay within 2020-07-27 through 2026-07-31, and have zero independent-range or V3 overlap; rapid_datasets contains zero local imports. The no-acquisition and no-protected-mutation findings rely on the audited operator command record and Git scope, not on Rapid database rows alone.
protected_state.enforcement_limit: The generic public CLI does not enforce the Rapid-003 2018-2019 seal. This program ran only exact catalog-bound commands for the named dataset and allowed range and ran no acquisition, local-import, or data-validation command.
